text_en: My teacher, and the chain of narration came from Ad-Din, and if it were not for the chain, whoever wished could say what he wished. It was in its beginning a chain of every narrator to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and originally the chain was continuous; every narrator narrates from his teacher and writes his name and the name of his teacher, and so on. Since every narrator needs to write his name and the name of his teacher from whom he hears the book, I mention here Imam al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, as this is the most common chain of scholars that reaches him, and from below it, the chain; every narrator writes 'I heard' with the name of his teacher in the apparent book, just as it was written in the manuscripts. When it reached Imam al-Qasim, he is a source here, so I say: I narrate this sheet with the authentic continuous chain to Imam al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, from his teacher Sayyid Amiruddin ibn Abdullah, from Sayyid Ahmad ibn Abdullah al-Wazir, from Imam Sharaf ad-Din, from his teacher Sayyid Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Wazir, from Imam Mutahhar ibn Muhammad ibn Sulaiman, from Imam Mahdi Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Salman ibn Ibrahim ibn Umar al-Alawi, from his father Ibrahim, from Ridha ad-Din Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Tabari, from Imam Najim ad-Din al-Tibrizi, from Al-Hafiz Ibn Asakir, from Zahir al-Sanhani, from Al-Hafiz al-Bayhaqi, from Abu al-Qasim al-Mufassir, from Ibrahim ibn Ja'dah, from Abu al-Qasim Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Amir al-Tayi in Basra. He said: My father narrated to me two hundred and sixty years. Ali ibn Musa al-Radi narrated to me with peace be upon him one hundred and ninety-four years. My father narrated to me.

Musa ibn Ja'far said: My father, Ja'far ibn Muhammad, narrated to me. He said: My father, Muhammad ibn Ali, narrated to me. He said: My father, Ali ibn Al-Husayn, narrated to me. He said: My father, Al-Husayn ibn Ali narrated to me. He said: My father narrated to me from Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them all. Amen until the Day of Judgment. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Allah Almighty says: There is no god but Allah, my fortress. Whoever enters my fortress is safe from My punishment.

And by its mentioned chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Indeed, Allah Almighty is a pillar of red ruby whose head is beneath the Throne and below it on the back of the whale in the seventh lowest earth. When the servant says 'La ilaha illallah', the Throne shakes, the pillar moves, and the whale moves. Then Allah Almighty says, 'Dwell upon My Throne.' He asks, 'How shall I dwell when you have not forgiven the one who said it?' So Allah Almighty says, 'Bear witness to the inhabitants of My heavens that I have indeed forgiven the one who said it.'

And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: Whoever says when entering the market: Subhan Allah wa alhamdulillah wa la ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamutu bi yadihi al-khayr wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. He was given reward equal to the number of things Allah created until the Day of Judgment.

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Faith is an acknowledgment by the tongue, and a knowledge in the heart, and an action with the limbs.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Allah says: There is no creature that clings to a creature other than Me; I will cut off the means of the heavens and the earth from it. If it asks Me, I will not give it, and if it calls Me, I will not answer it. And there is no creature that clings to Me other than My creation; I will guarantee the heavens and the earth with its provision. If it asks Me, I will give it, and if it calls Me, I will answer it. And if it seeks forgiveness from Me, I will forgive it.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'The best deeds before Allah are faith in which there is no doubt, and raiding in which there is no embezzlement, and a blessed Hajj. And the first to enter Paradise is a martyr, and a slave who worships his Lord best, and advised his master, and a chaste man who is self-sufficient with dependents. And the first to enter the Fire is an oppressor who does not render justice, and a wealthy person who does not fulfill his right, and a poor person who boasts.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever memorizes forty hadiths for my Ummah, they will benefit from them on the Day of Resurrection; Allah has appointed him as a scholar and a jurist.'

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever gives a fatwa to people without knowledge, the heavens and the earth curse him.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Reliance (Tawakkul) and Tawhid are half of the religion. And they descend provision from Allah by charity (Sadaqah).' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Indeed, Moses ibn Imran asked his Lord, so he raised his hands, and he said, "How far are you, my Lord?" So I called you, or am I near? He whispered to me, "O Moses, I am a companion of whoever remembers me.

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Six things are part of chivalry. Three of them are in the city and three are in travel. As for those in the city, they are reciting the Quran, building mosques, and taking brothers in Allah. As for those in travel, they are spending provisions, good character, and joking without disobeying Allah Almighty.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'O Allah, have mercy on my successors three times.' He was asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, who are your successors?' He replied, 'Those who come after me and narrate my hadith and Sunnah and teach it to people after me.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Indeed, this knowledge is the treasuries of Allah and its keys. So ask, and may Allah have mercy on you, for in it there are four rewards: the asker, the teacher, the listener, and the one who loves it.' And on his chain, he said: My father narrated to me, Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them, who said: 'The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said:'

And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Satan remains harassing the son of Adam as long as he maintains the five prayers; if he misses them, he becomes bold against him and casts him into major sins.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever fulfills a ritual (fard), he has an answered prayer with Allah.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'My Ummah remains well as long as they love each other, fulfill the trusts, avoid what is forbidden, honor the guest, establish salat, and give zakat; if they do not do that, they will be tested by years and drought.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'If a man cannot pray standing, he should pray sitting; if he cannot pray sitting, he should pray lying on his back facing the Qibla, making gestures.'

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Guard the five prayers, for indeed Allah Almighty, on the Day of Resurrection, calls a servant, and the first thing He asks about is prayer. So if it comes to him complete, else [he will go] into the Fire.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said to his companions: 'Do not neglect your prayers, for whoever neglects his prayer will be resurrected with Qarun, Pharaoh, and Haman. And it was a right due to Allah that he [will enter] the Fire with the hypocrites. And woe to whosoever does not maintain his prayer and perform the Sunnah of his Prophet.' And on his chain, Ali (may Allah bless him) said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, prayed for us the travel prayer, and he recited in the first [prayer] Al-Hamd, 'Say, you disbelievers,' and in the other [prayer] Al-Hamd and 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad.' Then he said: 'I have read to you one third of the Qur'an and one fourth.' And on his chain, it was narrated that Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) was asked about prayer, and he claimed that his father used to shorten the prayer while traveling.

"Abu Ubayda narrated from him, and by his chain, he said: I saw the Prophet, peace be upon him, perform five takbirs for his uncle Al-Hamza, and after that, five takbirs for the martyrs. So, he joined Al-Hamza with seventy takbirs and placed his right hand on his left one. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to Ali, 'When you pray over a corpse, say: O Allah, this is your servant and son of your Ummah. In it is Your judgment, and it was not anything mentioned that visited you, and You are the best visitor. O Allah, teach him his argument, join him with Your Prophet, and illuminate for him in his grave, and widen for him at his entrance, and strengthen him with the established saying, for he needs You and You are independent of him. And he used to testify that there is no god but You, so forgive him. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, nor test us after him.' O Ali, when you pray over a woman, say: O Allah, You created her, and You gave her life, and You are her Lord, and You know her secret and her open state. We come to You as intercessors for her, so forgive her. O Allah, do not deprive us of her reward, nor test us after her.' O Ali, when you pray over a child, say: O Allah, make him a predecessor and treasure for his parents, and make him abundant, and make him a light and guidance for them, and grant the Paradise to his parents. Indeed, You are capable of everything.' The Fourth Chapter on the Virtue of Ahl al-Bayt, which is three sections. The first section is about the virtue of Ali ibn Abi Talib, may Allah be pleased with him: And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to Ali, 'I am the master of the messengers, and you are the lion of the believers and the leader of the pious and the commander of those in the prime of life.' Abu al-Qasim al-Tayi said: I asked Ahmad ibn Yahya about the *ya'sūb* (lion). He said: The mention is from the bee that precedes it and defends it. And by his chain, he said: When I was taken by Allah to heaven, Gabriel took my hand and seated me on your couch of the gardens. Then he gave me a piece of silk from it. While I was turning it over, it split open, and a beautiful maiden came out whom I had not seen anyone as beautiful as her. She said: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad. I asked: Who are you? She said: The Almighty created me from three types: my lower part is musk, my middle part is camphor, and my upper part is amber. He mixed me with the water of the animal. Then the Almighty said to me: 'Be,' and I was. For your brother and cousin Ali ibn Abi Talib. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to Ali, 'I asked my Lord for five qualities concerning you, and He gave them to me. As for the first, I asked my Lord that the earth should split open from me and shake off the dust from my head while you were with me, and He gave it to me. As for the second, I asked my Lord that He should stop me at the scale of the balance while you were with me, and He gave it to me. As for the third, I asked my Lord to make you the bearer of the banner, which is the greatest banner of Allah, under which are the successful and victorious in Paradise, and He gave it to me. As for the fourth, I asked my Lord that you should give drink to my Ummah from my fountain, and He gave it to me. As for the fifth, I asked my Lord that you should make yourself the leader of my Ummah to Paradise, and He gave it to me. By the grace of Allah, praise be to Him who bestowed this favor upon me.'

And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to Ali, 'If it were the Day of Resurrection, I would take from you the rope of God, and I would take for myself my rope, and your son would take for himself his rope, and your grandchildren would take for themselves their ropes. Then you would see where they lead us.' Abu al-Qasim at-Tayyee asked Abu al-Abbas ibn Thulb about the rope, and he said: 'It is the cause (or reason).' He asked Ibn Nafatwayh the grammarian about it, and he said: 'It is the cause (or reason).' And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to Ali, 'Indeed, you are the divider of the Fire and Paradise, and indeed you knock on the door of Paradise, and enter it without reckoning.' And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to Ali, 'If it were the Day of Resurrection, you and your son would be on horses, adorned with gold and sapphire. Then Allah would command you into Paradise, and people would look on.' And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, 'If it were the Day of Resurrection, I would be called from the wombs of the Throne. Yes, my father is Abraham, and my brother is Ali ibn Abi Talib.' And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said that Allah commanded me to love four people: Ali, Salman, Abu Dharr, and Al-Miqdad ibn al-Aswad.' And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said to Ali, 'Indeed, Allah has forgiven you, your progeny, your followers, the lover of your followers, and the lover of the lovers of your followers. So rejoice! For you are now removed from the womb, removed from polytheism, and filled with knowledge.'

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever is my Mawla, Ali is his Mawla. O Allah, give allegiance to whomever you have given allegiance to, and turn away from whomever you have turned away from, and abandon whomever you abandoned, and support whomever you supported.'"

"And on his chain, he said: Narrated to me by Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, who said: 'I inherited two books from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him: the Book of Allah Almighty, and a book in my scabbard.' Someone asked, 'O Commander of the Faithful, what is the book in your scabbard?' He said: 'Whoever kills without killing, or strikes without striking, he deserves the curse of Allah.'"

"And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'O Ali, if it were not for you, the believers would not have known after me.'

And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and the family, said, 'O Ali, you have been given three things that I was not given like them.' He said, 'By my father and my mother, what was not given to me?' He said, [peace be upon him] 'I was given a son-in-law like me, and I was given something like your daughter Fatima, and I was given something like your two sons, Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and the family, said, 'O Ali, there will be no rider on Judgment Day except us, and we are four.' A man from the Ansar stood up to him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, who are they?' He said, 'I am on the Buraq mount, and my brother Saleh is on God's camel that was tied, and my uncle Hamza is on my lame camel, and my brother Ali ibn Abi Talib is on a camel from the camels of Paradise, and in his hand is the banner of praise calling, "There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah," so the people of Adam say, "What is this except an angel near or a prophet sent or one who carries the throne?" He answers them with an angel from the wombs of the Throne, "O assembly of the people of Adam, he is neither an angel near nor a prophet sent nor one who carries the throne; this is Ali ibn Abi Talib.

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'My daughter Fatima will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment with clothes dyed with the blood of Hussein. She will hang from a pillar of the Throne and say, "O Lord, judge between me and the killer of my son." The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: He will rule for my daughter, by the Lord of the Kaaba.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'My daughter Fatima will be resurrected with a garment of nobility that has been mixed with the water of life. When creation sees her, they will be amazed by her. Then she will also wear two garments from the garments of Paradise, written on each garment in green ink: "Enter the daughter of Muhammad into Paradise." She will be presented to Paradise as a bride, and seventy thousand maidservants will be entrusted with her.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'If it is the Day of Judgment, an announcer will call from the depths of the Throne, "O assembly of creation, lower your gazes until Fatima bint Muhammad, peace be upon her, passes.

And by his chain, he said: Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, we were with the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, in the trench when Fatima, peace be upon her, came with her a small piece of bread, so she pushed it to the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him. He said: What is this small piece? She said: A barley flatbread I baked for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn. I brought you this small piece from it. He said: O Fatima, is this the first food that entered your father since three days. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, told me: An angel came to me and said: O Muhammad, indeed Allah Almighty sends you greetings and says: I have married Fatima to Ali, so marry her to him. And the Tree of Paradise has been commanded to bear pearls, coral, and jewels, and the people of heaven have rejoiced with this, and two sons will be born to them, by whom the people of paradise will be adorned. So rejoice, O Muhammad, for you are the best of the first and the last. And by his chain, he said: My father narrated to me, Ali ibn Al-Husayn, who said: As-Sama'a bint Umays narrated to me: I was at your grandmother Fatima, peace be upon her, when the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, entered, and around her was a necklace of gold that Ali ibn Abi Talib bought for her from his wealth. The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said to her: Do not let people deceive you by saying 'daughter of Muhammad,' and you are wearing the garment of the mighty ones. I cut it up and sold it, and she bought a slave girl and freed her, so the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, rejoiced with that. The third section is about the virtue of Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn and their birth and the Ahl al-Bayt, peace be upon them all: And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are the masters of the youth of Paradise, and their father is better than them. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: The son is a fragrant plant, and my two fragrances are Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn. And by his chain, he said: Ali ibn Abi Talib narrated to me that Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn were playing near the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, until the night passed. Then he said, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him: Go back to your mother. So a light shone with radiance, and it kept shining for them until they entered Fatima, and the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, was looking at the cow, so he said: Praise be to Allah who honored the Ahl al-Bayt with us. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: The stars are a protection for the people of heaven, and my household and my children are a protection for my Ummah. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: Paradise is forbidden to whoever wrongs my household and fights them, and the helper for them, and whoever insults them—they have no share in the Hereafter, nor will Allah speak to them on the Day of Judgment, nor will He purify them, and they will have a painful torment. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: There are four people who will intercede for them on the Day of Judgment: the one who honors my progeny, the one who fulfills their needs, the one who strives for them in their affairs when they are distressed, and the one who loves them with his heart and tongue. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said: We are a household to whom charity is not permissible, and we were commanded to perform ablution thoroughly, and never to let a donkey ride on a fine garment.
And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever curses a prophet shall be killed, and whoever curses the companion of a prophet shall be exiled.'

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'The wrath of Allah intensified, and the Prophet's wrath was upon whoever shed the blood of my progeny or harmed me in my household.' And on his chain, he said Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them): 'Saturday is for us, Sunday is for our Shi'a, Monday is for Banu Umayya, Tuesday is for their Shi'a, Wednesday is for Al-Abbas, Thursday is for their Shi'a, and Friday is for Allah; there is no travel on it.' And by his chain, he said: 'Allah Almighty said: When you finish the prayer, disperse upon the earth and seek from the bounty of Allah,' meaning on Saturday. And by his chain, he said: 'Abu Musa ibn Ja'far narrated to me that Muhammad ibn Ali had a ring on it: By God, good is in the Prophet entrusted, and by the Guardian with favors, and by the righteous Husayn and Hasan.' And by his chain, he said: 'Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) said: The masters of people in this world are the generous, and the masters of people in the Hereafter are the pious.' And by his chain, he said: 'Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) said: Wellness is a hidden kingdom.'"

وباسناده قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله اشتد غضب الله وغضب رسول على من أهرق دم ذريتي أو أذاني في عترتي. وباسناده قال جعفر بن محمد عليهما السلام: السبت لنا والاحد لشيعتنا والاثنين لبني امية والثلاثاء لشيعتهم والاربعاء لبني العباس والخميس لشيعتهم والجمعة لله وليس فيه سفر، قال الله تعالى فإذا قضيت الصلاة فانتشروا في الارض وابتغوا من فضل الله يعني يوم السبت. وباسناده قال: حدثني أبو موسى بن جعفر قال: كان على خاتم محمد بن علي ظني بالله حسن وبالنبي المؤتمن وبالوصي ذي المنن وبالخيرين الحسين والحسن. وباسناده قال: قال علي بن الحسين عليهما السلام، سادات الناس في الدنيا الاسخياء وسادات الناس في الآخرة الاتقياء. وباسناده قال: قال علي بن الحسين عليهما السلام، العافية ملك خفي.

"And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'The wrath of Allah intensified, and the Prophet's wrath was upon whoever shed the blood of my progeny or harmed me in my household.' And on his chain, he said Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them): 'Saturday is for us, Sunday is for our Shi'a, Monday is for Banu Umayya, Tuesday is for their Shi'a, Wednesday is for Al-Abbas, Thursday is for their Shi'a, and Friday is for Allah; there is no travel on it.' And by his chain, he said: 'Allah Almighty said: When you finish the prayer, disperse upon the earth and seek from the bounty of Allah,' meaning on Saturday. And by his chain, he said: 'Abu Musa ibn Ja'far narrated to me that Muhammad ibn Ali had a ring on it: By God, good is in the Prophet entrusted, and by the Guardian with favors, and by the righteous Husayn and Hasan.' And by his chain, he said: 'Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) said: The masters of people in this world are the generous, and the masters of people in the Hereafter are the pious.' And by his chain, he said: 'Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) said: Wellness is a hidden kingdom.'

Abu Ubayda narrated from him, and by his chain he said: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib said, the Messenger of Allah peace be upon him, who said: Whoever performs an action for one of the sons of Abd al-Muttalib and does not reward him for it, then I will reward him tomorrow when I meet him on the Day of Judgment.' And by his chain he said: 'Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) that the Prophet peace be upon him granted permission to Hasan and Husayn regarding praying over them on the day they were born.' And by his chain he said: 'My father Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) narrated to me, who said: Asma bint Umays told me: Your grandmother Fatima greeted Hasan and Husayn peace be upon them. When Hasan peace be upon him was born, the Prophet peace be upon him came and said: O Asma, bring my son.' So I handed him to him in a yellow cloth. The Prophet peace be upon him threw it and said: O Asma, did I not warn you that you should not throw the newborn in a yellow cloth? So I put it in a white cloth and handed it to him. He granted permission for his right ear and stood in his left ear. Then he said peace be upon him with what name did you name this son of mine, O Ali? He said: I would not precede you with his name, O Messenger of Allah. And I used to love to name him Harb. So he said: I will not precede him with the name of my Lord, Mighty and Majestic. Then Gabriel peace be upon him came and said: The Exalted sends you greetings and tells you to name him after Ibn Harun. So he said: What is the name of Ibn Harun? He said: Shubayr. So he said: My tongue is Arabic. So name him Hasan. So Asma said, and he was named Hasan. When it was his seventh day, the Prophet peace be upon him performed for him two salted lambs, shaved his head, gave charity by weight of hair, and covered his head with Khulooq. Then he said: The blood is the custom of Jahiliyyah. So Asma said. When a year passed after the birth of Hasan peace be upon him, Husayn peace be upon him was born. The Prophet peace be upon him came and said: O Asma, bring my son.' So I handed him to him in a white cloth. He granted permission for his right ear and stood in his left. And placed him on his lap, so he cried. Asma said: May Allah grant you life from your crying. So he said: Who is this son of mine? I said: He is the child of the Hour. So he said: The hostile group will kill him after me; I will not attain them with my intercession. Then he said: Do not tell Fatima, for she is new to his children. Then he said: O Ali peace be upon you, with what name did you name this son of mine? He said: I would not precede you with his name, O Messenger of Allah. And I used to love to name him Harb. So he said: I will not precede him with the name of my Lord, Mighty and Majestic. Then Gabriel peace be upon him came and said: The Almighty sends you greetings and tells you to name him after Ibn Harun. So he said: What is the name of Ibn Harun? He said: Shubayr. So he said: My tongue is Arabic. So name him Husayn. So he named him. Then the Prophet peace be upon him performed for him on the seventh day with two salted lambs, shaved his head, gave charity by weight of hair, and covered his head with Khulooq, and said: The blood is the custom of Jahiliyyah, and gave the midwife to take a lamb.

And on his chain, he said: My father narrated to me, Ali ibn Al-Husayn, peace be upon them both, that he named Husn on his seventh day and derived it from the name of Al-Hasan. Al-Husayn mentioned that there was nothing between them except pregnancy. And on his chain, he said: My father narrated to me, Ali ibn Al-Husayn, peace be upon them both, that when Ali ibn Al-Husayn entered the resting place, he found a piece of bread lying down. He pushed it to a boy of his and said, 'O boy, remind me about this piece of bread when you leave and eat it.' When Al-Husayn, peace be upon him, left, he said, 'O boy, where is the piece of bread?' He said, 'I ate it, my master.' So Al-Husayn, peace be upon him, said, 'You are free by the will of Allah Almighty.' A man told him, 'I freed you, my lord.' He said, 'Yes. I heard my grandfather, the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him and his progeny, saying: "Whoever finds a piece of bread lying down, he wipes from it what he can wipe, washes what he can wash, and then eats it; it will not settle in his stomach until Allah frees him from the Fire. And I would not enslave a man whom Allah freed from the Fire.

And by its chain, he said: Abu al-Qasim al-Tayyahi may Allah have mercy on him said: 'Ali ibn Musa al-Radi may Allah be pleased with him said: My father narrated from me; my father Musa ibn Ja'far said: My grandfather narrated from me; my grandfather Ja'far ibn Muhammad said: My father narrated from me; my father Muhammad ibn Ali said: My father narrated from me; my father Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: My father narrated from me; my father Al-Husayn ibn Ali said: My father narrated from me; my father Ali ibn Abi Talib, may Allah be pleased with them all. He said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Musa ibn Imran raised his hands and said, "O Lord, indeed my brother Harun has died, so forgive him." So Allah revealed to him: "O Musa, if you ask Me concerning the first people and the last people, I will answer you, except for the killer of Al-Husayn; for I do not forgive him and I take vengeance from his killer." Chapter Five on the virtue of the believer, good character, and the virtue of one named Muhammad or Ahmad. And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "The believer is with Allah like a close angel, but the believer with Allah is better than a close angel. There is nothing more beloved to Allah than a repentant believer or a repentant believing woman." And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "The believer is known in the sky as a man knows his family and offspring, and indeed he is more honored with Allah than a close angel." And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Gabriel came to me from his Lord, and he was saying: "My Lord, may He be Mighty, sends you greetings and says, 'O Muhammad, give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds, believe in you, and love your household; for they have with Me the reward of bliss, and they will enter Paradise.'" And by its chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "Whoever treats people and does not wrong them, informs them and does not lie to them, and promises them and does not fail them, he is a believer whose chivalry is complete, whose justice has appeared, whose love is obligatory, and whose absence is forbidden.

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever slanders a believing man or woman, or says about them what is not in them, Allah will place him on a mound of fire until he exits what he said.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'The miracle of the believer is that Allah does not make for it a known time, until he thinks about a calamity. When he thinks about a calamity, Allah seizes him out of compassion.' Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: Ja'far ibn Muhammad used to say: 'Avoid calamities; Allah will extend your lifespan.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Hold fast to good character, for good character is inevitably in Paradise.'

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'If the Day of Resurrection occurs, Allah will manifest Himself to His believing servant, stopping him at his sins, sin by sin. Then Allah will forgive him, and no angel close nor prophet sent will know this, and He will cover over him what anyone dislikes to see him exposed to. Then he will say regarding his sins: 'They are like good deeds.' And on his chain, he said: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Whoever belittles a believing man or woman, or looks down upon him because of his poverty or the little of his wealth, Allah will expose him on the Day of Resurrection, then disgrace him.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'The servant attains with good character the rank of the fasting person and the standing person.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'There is nothing heavier in the scale than good character.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Bad character spoils deeds just as honey spoils milk.'

And on his chain, he said: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him narrated to me from the treasures of Al-Barra, that it is abandoning action and patience upon calamities and concealing misfortunes.' And on his chain, he said: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him narrated to me, good character is the best companion. And he said: "The most complete among you in iman are those with the best manners." And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, stated: "The title of Sahifat al-Muslim is good character." And on his chain, from Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, was asked: 'What is most likely to enter Paradise?' He said: 'Taqwa of Allah and good character.' And [he was] asked: 'What is most likely to enter the Fire?' He said: 'The two hollows, the stomach and the private parts.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'The closest among you to me in sitting on the Day of Resurrection are those with the best character, and the best of you are those who are best to their families.'

"And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'The person with the best faith is the one with the best character and the most tender to his family. And I am the most tender to you regarding your families.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'If you name a child Muhammad, honor him and give him space in the gathering, and do not disfigure his face.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'There is no people for whom consultation was held, and who attended with someone named Muhammad or Ahmad, that they would enter him into their last consultation.' And by his narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'There is no table placed on which ate someone named Muhammad or Ahmad, except that God blessed that place twice every day.' Chapter Six concerning the mention of foods, fruits, and oils. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'The master of food in this world and the Hereafter is meat, and the master of drink in this world and the Hereafter is water. And I am the master of the progeny of Adam, no boasting.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger, peace be upon him, said: 'The master of food in this world and the Hereafter is meat and rice.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'When you cook, increase squash because it strengthens the heart of the sad one.' And by his chain, he said: My father narrated to me, Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, who said: 'Be careful with squash because it increases in the brain.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'When you eat Tharid, eat from its sides because the peak has a blessing.' And by his chain, he said: Ali ibn Abi Talib narrated to me, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever wants to remain and there is no remaining, let him wake up for lunch, master the shoe, lighten the cloak, and reduce the veiling of women.' And by his chain, he said: When the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, ate food, he would say: 'O Allah, bless it for us and grant us better from it.' And when he drank milk, he would say: 'O Allah, bless it for us and grant us better from it.' And by his chain, he said: When the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, drank milk and gargled with it, he said that it has a fatness.

And by his chain, he said: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, was given the Prophet, peace and grace be upon him, food, so he inserted his finger, and behold, it was hot. So he said, peace be upon him, "Leave it until it cools, for indeed it is a great blessing, for Allah Almighty did not feed us what was hot." And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and grace be upon him, said, "Be mindful of meat, for indeed meat causes growth. And whoever abandons meat for forty days, his character will be bad." And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and grace be upon him, said, "Be mindful of lentils, for indeed they are blessed and sacred, they move the heart and increase tears. And indeed seventy prophets were blessed with it, the last of whom was Jesus son of Mary, peace be upon them both." And by his chain, he said: Ali, peace be upon him, mentioned fat and meat to the Prophet, peace and grace be upon him. He said: "There is nothing from them whose portion falls into the stomach except that it grows in its place a healing, and exits from its place an illness.

And by his chain, he said: 'O Ali, peace be upon him, whoever starts with salt, Allah will take away from him seventy diseases, the first of which is leprosy.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Be mindful of salt for it is a cure for seventy diseases, including leprosy, vitiligo, and madness.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'There is nothing more hateful to Allah than a full stomach.' And by his chain, he said: My father narrated to me, Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace upon him. Abu Juhaifah said: I came to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, while belching, so he said to me, 'O Abu Juhaifah, restrain your belching, for most people who are full in this world will be the hungriest on the Day of Resurrection.' He asked, 'What is it, O Abu Juhaifah?' He did not fill his stomach with food until he met Allah Almighty.

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: 'Do not nurse the lame or the blind, for milk exceeds [its natural limit].' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: 'There is no milk better for a boy than the milk of his mother.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: 'What falls from the board are the dowries of the Houris.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: 'Whoever provides sustenance well has a good deed.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: 'The best provision is the vinegar; and the people in our household have not lacked it.'
And by his chain, he said: 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, eat the grapes; whatever is spoiled do not eat it, and do not eat what you have corrupted yourselves.'

And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Eat the grapes, a single berry, for it is an ailment and a cure.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Be mindful of raisins, for they remove bitterness, and take away phlegm, and strengthen the sinew, and improve character, and sweeten the soul, and dispel worry.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'If there is a cure in anything, it is in the bandage of the barber or a sip of honey.' And on his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Do not refuse a sip of honey that comes to you.'
Abu Ubayda narrated from Jabir ibn Zayd, from the Prophet, peace be upon him, who said: 'Actions are judged by intentions.'
Abu Ubayda narrated from Jabir ibn Zayd, from the Prophet, peace be upon him, who said: 'Actions are judged by intentions.'

And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'The best deeds of my Ummah are waiting for the relief of Allah.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Your mouths are ways to your Lord, so purify them.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever fasts on Friday with patience and seeking reward will be given the reward of ten days, a splendor unlike the days of this world.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Allah decreed the measures and managed the arrangements before He created Adam in two thousand years.'

The Book of the Prophet, peace be upon him, said: 'Increase kissing your children for you have in every kiss a degree in Paradise between the two degrees five hundred years until the angels count and write what you kissed. Marry and do not divorce for divorce shakes the Throne. The prayer of a married person is better than forty prayers of an unmarried person. Two rak'ahs from a married woman are better than seventy rak'ahs without a ring. A covering (or shroud) of winds and dew upon the grave of the believer is an atonement for his sins. Hang the falling object in the house so that the servant escapes, and the people of the house, for it is good manners for them.' The youth's playfulness in childhood is an increase in his intellect when he grows up, and playfulness is also a lack of modesty. Whoever has long eyelashes will not have his prayer answered. This book contains much regarding the virtue of knowledge and the virtue of the scholar and the student; what was intended was taken from it.

And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'There are six things of chivalry; three of them in the city and three in travel. As for those in the city, they are reciting the Qur'an, building mosques, and taking brothers in Allah. As for those in travel, they are spending provisions, good character, and joking without disobeying Allah Almighty. And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'O Allah, have mercy on my successors three times.' He was asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, who are your successors?' He said: 'Those who come after me and narrate my hadith and Sunnah and teach it to people after me.' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Indeed, this knowledge is the treasuries of Allah, and its keys are in asking. So ask, may Allah have mercy on you, for indeed, one is rewarded therein: the asker, the teacher, the listener, and the lover thereof.' And by his chain, he said: My father narrated to me, Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, who said: He said: 'Five things; if you enter into them, you will not be able to match them. A servant does not fear except his sin, nor hopes except his Lord, nor is the ignorant ashamed when asked about what he does not know. Say Allah and His Messenger know best, and the one who does not feel ashamed of learning, and patience is from iman (faith) like the head is to the body, and there is no faith for one who has no patience.' And by his chain, he said: Al-Husayn ibn Ali narrated to me, peace be upon them both, who said: I found a tablet under a wall in a city of Madain, written on it: 'I am Allah; there is no god but I, and Muhammad is my prophet.' How strange are those who are certain of death—how they rejoice! And how strange are those who are certain of destiny—how they grieve! And how strange are those who are tested by the world—how they feel secure in it! And how strange are those who are certain of reckoning—how they sin!' And by his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: 'Whoever recites [the verse] "When the earth is shaken

By his chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Moses asked his Lord, the Mighty and Majestic, saying: 'My Lord, make me a nation of Muhammad.' So Allah revealed to him that, 'O Moses, you will not reach that.'
